subject.title: feat: version field in health response + POST /admin/update endpoint

question: Should OpenClaw expose host update execution through an authenticated HTTP operator surface, and if so should that reuse the existing default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin instead of adding a bespoke `/admin/update` endpoint?
rationale: Current main already has `update.run` as an admin-scoped Gateway RPC and a default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin, but deciding whether host package-manager update execution may cross HTTP is a security and product boundary choice.

options.title: Reuse admin HTTP RPC after approval
options.body: If maintainers approve HTTP update execution, add `update.run` to the default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin with explicit private-ingress docs, schema/tests, and upgrade proof.

options.title: Keep update execution WebSocket-only
options.body: Leave `update.run` off HTTP and direct fleet tooling to WebSocket RPC or a local trusted helper until a stronger HTTP boundary is chosen.

options.title: Design a separate endpoint
options.body: Add a bespoke authenticated update endpoint only if maintainers decide the existing RPC shape cannot support fleet tooling safely.

recommendation.title: Reuse admin HTTP RPC after approval
recommendation.body: If maintainers approve HTTP update execution, add `update.run` to the default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin with explicit private-ingress docs, schema/tests, and upgrade proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current admin HTTP RPC plugin and adjacent Gateway HTTP/security boundary work.
